documents.title: バス時刻表
documents.text: Campus shuttle: City stop 8:10, 8:40, 9:10. Campus arrival 8:30, 9:00, 9:30. No Sunday service.

documents.title: カフェメニュー
documents.text: Tea $4.00; coffee $5.00; sandwich $8.50. Oat milk available for an extra $1.00.

documents.title: 授業メール
documents.text: Hi class, tomorrow's lesson will start at 10 am in Room B12 instead of Room A10. Please bring your workbook. Thanks, Sam.

documents.title: 家庭のルール
documents.text: Please leave your shoes by the front door. Dinner is usually at 6 pm. If you will be late, please send us a message.

documents.title: 施設掲示
documents.text: Library opening hours: Monday to Friday 8 am–8 pm; Saturday 10 am–4 pm; closed Sunday. Return books at the desk.

documents.title: 返品案内
documents.text: Keep your receipt. Unused items may be returned within 14 days. This policy does not limit your legal rights.

documents.title: 課題指示
documents.text: Write 150 words about a place you know. Include two reasons why you like it. Submit your work by Friday at 5 pm.

documents.title: 予約確認
documents.text: Your appointment is on Tuesday at 2:30 pm. Please arrive ten minutes early and bring your ID.

documents.title: ごみ分別案内
documents.text: Put clean paper and cardboard in the recycling bin. Food scraps go in the food waste bin. Do not put plastic bags in either bin.

documents.title: 短い説明文
documents.text: Many students use public transport because it is cheaper than owning a car. However, buses may be less convenient in areas with few services. More frequent buses could help.

documents.title: 家の連絡メモ
documents.text: Dinner is at 6:30 tonight. If you will be late, please send a message before six. Your meal will be in the fridge.

documents.title: 交換条件
documents.text: You may exchange unused items within 14 days. Bring your receipt. Items marked final sale cannot be exchanged.

documents.title: バス運休案内
documents.text: Route 8 will not stop at King Street on Sunday. Please use the stop on Queen Street instead. Normal service resumes on Monday.

documents.title: 授業メール
documents.text: Tomorrow’s tutorial has moved to Room 204. The start time remains 10 am. Bring your notes from Chapter 3.

documents.title: 課題要項
documents.text: Write 150–200 words about a local issue. Include one example and submit your work online by Friday at noon.

documents.title: 施設案内
documents.text: The reception desk is open from 8 am to 5 pm on weekdays. For non-urgent enquiries after hours, email the office.

documents.title: 地域の掲示
documents.text: Please put clean paper and cardboard in the recycling bin. Food waste and plastic bags must go in separate bins.

documents.title: 原因と結果
documents.text: The library extended its opening hours during exams. As a result, students had more time to study after class. However, staffing costs increased.

documents.title: 比較と対照
documents.text: Online classes allow students to study from home. In-person classes offer more opportunities for face-to-face discussion. Both formats can be useful depending on the learner’s needs.

documents.title: 主張と要点
documents.text: A campus garden can provide a place for students to relax. It can also support practical learning. Although it requires maintenance, the benefits may justify the cost.
